title: Baked Hake with Mediterranean Flair
description: A simple yet flavorful fish dish with the perfect balance of Mediterranean flavors. This recipe is perfect for a quick and healthy dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the hake fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with oregano, garlic powder, and salt.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, mix the breadcrumbs with lemon juice in a small bowl.
Remove the fish from the oven and top each fillet with the breadcrumb mixture.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
